instruction: I want to set my current time zone to America/New_York. Can you help me?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting timezone to America/New_York (UTC-5/-4). Evaluator checks timedatectl output for correct timezone string. Verified by checking timedatectl output format: line 4 contains 'Time zone: <timezone>' pattern.
